manual_reconciliation.production_actor_routing: All eight convenience/item read/write sites explicitly use engine. Ordinary simulation/evaluator/effect/reward/spawn accesses use engine; publisher plan authorization uses agent. set_engine_value is fixed-engine checked API and is not an actor-default overload.
manual_reconciliation.raw_storage: Direct item tensor writes outside registry are reset/allocation lifecycle initialization. Expression item-reference reads are engine-internal reads with mandatory engine-read schema invariant. Publisher arena reads are behind agent-authorized immutable plans.
manual_reconciliation.intentional_tests: Omitted actors are TypeError controls; unsupported actor values and denied roles are PermissionError controls. Dynamic getattr parameterized accessor tests exercise explicit reader keyword and omitted-actor controls.
manual_reconciliation.hash_roster: Every hash call explicitly supplies the qualified item roster, including empty {}. Production compute_variable_schema_hash consumers are compiler, artifact coherence and registry frozen-policy identity; its implementation delegates to canonical_variable_schema with the same roster (four production syntactic sites total).
manual_reconciliation.dac_role: DACEngine.__init__ sets self.vfs_reader="engine"; all four role-variable reward calls pass that explicit role to checked get.
manual_reconciliation.excluded_generic_get_set: 314 excluded generic production get/set sites are retained for audit.
